question: Can historical actual-live position size and portfolio heat be reconstructed from existing Production receipts without inventing fills?

tradeJournalSignals.semantics: monitor/signal event ledger; signal_shares and market_price are advisory/observed, not broker-confirmed executions

positionReconciliation.semantics: mutable current-position snapshot; latest reconciliation audit overwrites a single KV receipt and is not an append-only fill history

falsificationRule: If any historical actual-live heat calculation substitutes suggested shares/price or current mutable position state for missing confirmed fills, reject it as fabricated.
